title: Follow up next week
recap: Pipo set up a follow-up for Jordan's next visit.
funFact: One bad review turned into a loyal customer. Agents can help you look after people, and you decide what to say and spend.
postcard: the café owner greeting Jordan at the door with a hot oat latte, the calendar showing {events}
situation: Want to welcome Jordan back properly? I can add a reminder for their next visit.
facts: ☕ Jordan's order: oat latte, extra hot
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly assistant for the owner of Bloom Café, a small local café. You can add events to the café calendar. You do what they ask: if they ask you to add events, you add them; if they ask to see them first, you line them up and wait for their OK.

tools.name: add_to_calendar
tools.description: Add the events to the calendar now. Use this when the user wants them added.

events.description: The events, each with a short name and when it happens (day and time)

when.description: Day and time, for example Tuesday 5pm

reminder.description: When to remind, for example 1 hour before

tools.name: show_events
tools.description: Line the events up and show them to the user without adding them, so they can check first. Use this when the user wants to see them before they go in.

events.description: The events, each with a short name and when it happens (day and time)

when.description: Day and time, for example Tuesday 5pm

reminder.description: When to remind, for example 1 hour before

lines.text: Lined up, waiting for your OK to add

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Add a follow-up for Jordan's next visit
pieces.text: Add an event to the café calendar to welcome Jordan back on their next visit.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: Next Tuesday at 8am
pieces.text: Jordan comes in on Tuesdays around 8am, so make it next Tuesday at 8am.

pieces.label: Note: oat latte, extra hot
pieces.text: In the event name, note Jordan's order: oat latte, extra hot.

pieces.label: Plan a surprise party!
pieces.text: Plan a surprise party for Jordan!
pieces.tip: A party is a lot for one cold coffee. Small and personal is what makes a customer feel looked after.

pieces.label: Show me before you add it
pieces.text: Show me the event before you add it.

pieces.label: Just add it
pieces.tip: Adding without a look means a wrong day can sit in the calendar unnoticed.

flaws.hint: "The Jordan thing" doesn't say what to remember.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know what to plan, so the event doesn't make sense.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when Jordan comes in.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know Jordan comes on Tuesdays, so it picked another day.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo Jordan's order.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know Jordan's order, so the reminder misses the personal touch.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when to remind you.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you want 15 minutes' notice, so it picked its own.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the event first lets you catch a wrong day.
flaws.explain: Pipo added it straight away, so you never got to check it.

lesson: Exact days, times and details turn "remember this" into a plan Pipo can act on.
